long_description: DaylightRx is an FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic that delivers guideline-recommended cognitive behavioral therapy for generalized anxiety disorder through a mobile app. The treatment uses video and audio lessons designed by anxiety experts to help patients understand and address the thoughts and behaviors that sustain anxiety. Clinical trials demonstrate that 71% of DaylightRx users achieve clinical improvement in anxiety symptoms, with lasting benefits beyond program completion. As the first-line treatment recommended by the Anxiety and Depression Association of America, DaylightRx is now reimbursable under Medicare with CMS billing codes effective January 2025, expanding access to evidence-based mental health care.

faqs.a: DaylightRx is an FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic that delivers cognitive behavioral therapy for generalized anxiety disorder through personalized video and audio lessons in a mobile app.
In clinical trials, 71% of DaylightRx users achieved clinical improvement in anxiety symptoms, with lasting benefits beyond program completion.
Yes, DaylightRx is reimbursable under Medicare Fee-for-Service and Medicare Advantage with CMS billing codes effective January 2025. It's also on the Evernorth Digital Health Formulary.

faqs.q: What is the difference between DaylightRx and Daylight?
faqs.a: DaylightRx is the FDA-cleared prescription version requiring a clinician prescription, while Daylight is the wellness version available through employers and health plans.
